name: CitedIndex

sources.title: Homepage — live 'neutral index of AI-visibility & GEO tools' (117 tools indexed, updated 26 Sep 2026)
Submit a listing — 'Sign in or create a free account, then share your website for review'; free account, no card required

conditions: Free submission requires creating a free account (no card required), then sharing the website for review
Niche gate: only AI-visibility monitoring, AI rank tracking, GEO/content optimization tools, and citation/GEO agencies fit the index
requirements: Product must fit one of four categories: AI visibility monitoring, AI rank tracking, GEO & content optimization, or citation services (agencies)
Account required before the website can be shared for review
Listings carry 'sources and qualifications on every record' — expect editorial fact-checking of claims
preparation: Website URL to submit for review
Pricing facts (the index displays per-tool price, e.g. 'Free, then $99', 'From $39/month')
Category fit: decide which of the four index categories the tool belongs to
If the tool is already indexed, use /claim instead and verify domain ownership
workflow: Create a free account (or sign in) — no card required
Share the website for review through the account flow
If the tool is already listed, use 'Find your listing to claim' (/claim) and verify connection to its domain
After acceptance the listing shows recorded views, visit clicks and referral sources in the account dashboard
watchFor: Very narrow niche — general SaaS/AI tools that are not about AI-search visibility will not fit
The submit page is account-gated; the actual form fields are behind sign-in and were not visible
Every record lists sources and qualifications — inflated claims likely get flagged
Separate /advertise and /pricing pages exist — paid placement is an upsell, not required for a basic listing
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the citedindex.com index (search or its category page) with a price and 'Checked' date, and the account dashboard shows its view/click stats
unknowns: Review criteria and turnaround after account creation
Exact submission form fields behind sign-in
